title: Battle of Saint-Raphaël
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Saint-Raphaël", at revision 1370273387, opens: "The Battle of Saint-Raphaël took place during the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889885, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1794 battle during the Haitian Revolution". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
